question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form, O beloved?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated.
The contemplation is to be done always.
The triple world is affected as a result.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object contemplated as smoke-colored is not explicitly named.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
